_about: Range Safety policy. Read by .claude/hooks/range-safety.js before every tool call a crew agent makes. Deterministic: an agent cannot argue its way past it. Only the Flight Director (a human) edits this file.
_shellModel: Bash commands are parsed into words the way bash splits them. Only plain words, quotes and the separators && || ; | are accepted; $, backticks, ( ) { } < > &, globs, backslashes and newlines are denied, so nothing hidden can run. The only redirections allowed are 2>&1, >/dev/null and 2>/dev/null; files are written with the Write or Edit tool. Each simple command must start with an entry below (an entry starting with = must match the whole command), and flags that start other programs or write files are denied. Adopted after Security cards 04, 06 and 08 found bypasses in regex-based checks.
_protectedFileNames: Agents can't write these anywhere in the repo: approvals are human-only, and CLAUDE.md / .mcp.json instruct or configure future agent sessions (writing them would be prompt injection across sessions).

blockedCommands.reason: Pushing is the Flight Director's step. Crew work stays local until a human approves.
Destructive git commands can throw away work.
No network access from the crew. Prevents data leaving and stops prompt-injected downloads.
No new packages. A new dependency needs a Chief Engineer ADR and human approval.
Deploy and cloud tools are human-only.
Privilege and permission changes are not allowed.
Dumping environment variables can expose secrets.

test-engineer.readDenyReason: The Test Engineer works from the spec only. It can't see the builder's unit tests or flight cards, so it can't inherit the builder's blind spots.
